headline.en: Organize a column before narrating it
headline.zh: 先整理栏目，再准备配音

sub.en: LanYin stores column configuration, extracts chapter titles from Markdown and registers episodes. It also provides a MiniMax client for recording a reusable voice profile; complete episode audio production remains unfinished.
sub.zh: 栏音保存栏目配置，从 Markdown 提取章节标题并登记每期内容，还提供 MiniMax 客户端记录可复用音色档案。完整单集音频制作流程尚未完成。

body.en: A configurable heading level becomes an ordered list of chapter titles.
body.zh: 按配置的标题级别提取有序章节列表。

body.en: Source paths and parsed chapter metadata are saved in .lanyin/episodes.json.
body.zh: 来源路径和解析后的章节元数据保存到 .lanyin/episodes.json。

body.en: A voice-lock file records the selected provider voice ID and its configuration.
body.zh: 音色锁文件记录选定的服务商 Voice ID 及其配置。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The example embeds a complete Markdown episode, creates a temporary column, saves its parsed chapters and reloads the registry. It produces metadata only.
note.zh: 示例内含完整 Markdown 单集内容，在临时目录创建栏目、保存解析后的章节并重新读取登记文件，只生成元数据。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Markdown heading parsing and local episode-registry round trip. No TTS request or synthesized audio.

body.en: The example embeds a complete Markdown episode, creates a temporary column, saves its parsed chapters and reloads the registry. It produces metadata only.
body.zh: 示例内含完整 Markdown 单集内容，在临时目录创建栏目、保存解析后的章节并重新读取登记文件，只生成元数据。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/lanyin.git
cd lanyin
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .

limitations.en: lanyin build is a stub and returns exit 2. It does not generate chaptered MP3 files.
limitations.zh: lanyin build 是占位入口，返回 2，不会生成带章节的 MP3。

limitations.en: RSS export needs built episodes; the current add workflow does not produce them. Example RSS URLs are illustrative, not published audio.
limitations.zh: RSS 导出需要已生成音频的单集，当前 add 流程不会产生它们。示例 RSS URL 是说明性内容，不代表已发布音频。

limitations.en: No voice quality, cross-episode consistency or platform ingestion was measured in the recorded example.
limitations.zh: 记录示例未测量音色质量、跨集一致性或平台导入。

body.en: A serialized audio project needs consistent episode structure and a clear record of which voice configuration it intends to use. LanYin keeps those preparation steps together so each article can be inspected before synthesis.
body.zh: 连载音频项目需要一致的单集结构，也需要明确记录准备使用的音色配置。栏音把这些准备工作放在一起，使每篇文章在合成前都可以检查。

body.en: config.py reads lanyin.toml and manages local registry files. chapter.py uses MarkdownIt to extract headings without raw emphasis syntax. The add command stores chapter data per source path. voice_lock.py uploads a selected reference through MiniMax and persists the resulting profile; synthesize_episode remains a NotImplementedError.
body.zh: config.py 读取 lanyin.toml 并管理本地登记文件；chapter.py 使用 MarkdownIt 提取标题、去掉强调等语法。add 按来源路径保存章节数据。voice_lock.py 通过 MiniMax 上传选定参考音频并保存返回档案；synthesize_episode 目前仍抛出 NotImplementedError。

title.zh: 用栏目元数据组织单集准备

body.en: config.py reads lanyin.toml and manages local registry files. chapter.py uses MarkdownIt to extract headings without raw emphasis syntax. The add command stores chapter data per source path. voice_lock.py uploads a selected reference through MiniMax and persists the resulting profile; synthesize_episode remains a NotImplementedError.
body.zh: config.py 读取 lanyin.toml 并管理本地登记文件；chapter.py 使用 MarkdownIt 提取标题、去掉强调等语法。add 按来源路径保存章节数据。voice_lock.py 通过 MiniMax 上传选定参考音频并保存返回档案；synthesize_episode 目前仍抛出 NotImplementedError。

alt.zh: 用栏目元数据组织单集准备

body.en: The local parser and registry work without API access. The voice-lock path requires a provider account and uploads a reference sample. generate_rss can format supplied episode metadata, but that helper does not synthesize audio, host files or prove acceptance by a podcast platform.
body.zh: 本地解析器和登记功能无需 API。音色锁路径需要服务商账户并上传参考样本。generate_rss 可将给定单集元数据生成 XML，但不会合成音频、托管文件或证明播客平台接收成功。

body.en: [column] defines column_id, column_name, chapter_heading_level (default 2) and platform_target (xiaoyuzhou or ximalaya). .lanyin/voice-lock.json stores the voice profile and .lanyin/episodes.json stores sources and chapter titles. MINIMAX_API_KEY is required for provider operations; MINIMAX_GROUP_ID is optional endpoint configuration. Chapter offsets start at zero because timed synthesis is not connected.
body.zh: [column] 定义 column_id、column_name、chapter_heading_level（默认 2）和 platform_target（xiaoyuzhou 或 ximalaya）。.lanyin/voice-lock.json 保存音色档案，.lanyin/episodes.json 保存来源及标题。服务商操作需要 MINIMAX_API_KEY，MINIMAX_GROUP_ID 是可选端点配置。由于带时间信息的合成流程尚未接通，章节偏移初始均为零。

body.en: Run init in the directory that will own lanyin.toml. add replaces the registry entry with the same source-path string, making repeated registration predictable. voice show prints an existing lock and exits 1 if none exists. To create one, configure the provider variables and use voice lock --sample ./voice.mp3 --name "Narrator" with a sample you are authorized to use.
body.zh: 在准备保存 lanyin.toml 的目录运行 init。add 会替换来源路径字符串相同的登记条目，便于重复更新。voice show 显示现有音色锁，未创建时返回 1。创建音色锁需配置服务商变量，再以有权使用的参考音频运行 voice lock --sample ./voice.mp3 --name "Narrator"。

details.code:
lanyin init my-column --heading-level 2
lanyin add ./examples/ep01.md
lanyin voice show
